text: I do not give trade instructions or size positions; entry and size are your decisions, and any size suggestion comes only from the sizing assistant in paper risk units. As context: the release-day WTI slope is -0.3481% per 1 sd crude surprise (t -5.7945, contemporaneous, not a forecast), and the next WPSR is on 2026-10-28. The surprise itself is unknown in advance, so the base rate explains reactions rather than predicting direction (inference).
